source.passage: • Meridian Power Limited reported group installed capacity of 12,000 MW on a consolidated basis as on 31 March 2025. • As on 31 March 2025, Meridian Power Limited has projects with a total capacity of 4,000 MW under implementation, including 3,000 MW being developed by joint venture and subsidiary companies. • As on 31 March 2025, Meridian's renewable capacity of 2,000 MW is under implementation, including 1,800 MW of renewable projects being developed by joint venture and subsidiary companies. • As on 31 March 2025, Meridian has a commissioned renewable capacity of 900 MW. • Meridian has set a target to achieve 5,000 MW of renewable capacity by 2032.
